newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end down, further slides seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end down, further slides seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished softer on Friday as banks continued to dump excess liquidity, and dealers expected further slides for next week.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.941 percent against Thursday's 4.971 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.90 against 4.95-5.00.
The maturation of T$5 billion in NCDs on Saturday and maturation of T$15 billion in treasury bills next week were expected to keep liquidity loose in the banking system.
The bond market was slugglish and dealers expected a consolidation to continue next week. --Rachel Lee (5080815)
